lines: // The plan's step identity is its declaration witness in each selected run.
.decl declared(run: symbol, step: symbol, reason: symbol)
.decl requirement(run: symbol, step: symbol, token: symbol, reason: symbol)
.decl refusal(run: symbol, step: symbol, reason: symbol)
// An expired deadline refuses its unfinished step at the inclusive boundary: the step is stuck and cannot be ready.
refusal(run, step, deadline) :- deadline_expired(run, step, _, deadline, _).
.decl eligible(run: symbol, step: symbol, reason: symbol)
eligible(run, step, reason) :- declared(run, step, reason), !blocked_step(run, step).
